title: B.FRIENDit RF1430 Wireless Keyboard Full Size Slim w/ Number Pad
descriptionText:
Used – Good condition. Fully functional with some light surface scratches from normal use (see photos). Clean and ready for use.

Description:

For sale is a B.FRIENDit RF1430 Wireless Keyboard, a full-size slim wireless keyboard with a built-in number pad. Ideal for home, office, or mobile workstation setups, this keyboard combines sleek design with functionality. Works great with most Windows PCs and some smart devices (USB receiver required – not included).

Details:

Brand: B.FRIENDit
Model: RF1430
Color: Black keys with silver trim
Layout: Full-size (includes number pad)
Connectivity: Wireless (USB receiver required - not included)
Power: DC 3V (2.5mA) – typically powered by AAA batteries
Origin: Made in China
Serial Number: 20015000133
Features:

Low-profile chiclet keys for quiet and comfortable typing
Integrated function keys (media, volume, etc.) via Fn key
LED indicators for Num Lock, Caps Lock, etc.
Lightweight and portable
What’s Included:

B.FRIENDit RF1430 Wireless Keyboard only
(No USB receiver or batteries included)
